admin_cleanup.shared_limits: Other limits below are shared safety limits, not per-plan overrides. No per-plan duration limit is currently enforced.
admin_cleanup.adjust_help: Monthly credit changes apply at the next unallocated cycle. Current credits and past allocations stay unchanged. Concurrency changes apply immediately while this agreement is active. Start a new correction for a different decision.
admin_cleanup.agreement_ended: Only a current or scheduled agreement can be adjusted.
admin_cleanup.agreement_adjusted: Agreement updated. Monthly credit changes begin at the next unallocated cycle.
admin_cleanup.agreement_plan: Select an active non-Free base plan.
admin_cleanup.agreement_migration: Agreement controls require the pending agreement concurrency migration. Existing agreement history remains available.
admin_cleanup.mcp_note: Plan eligibility, enabled service, authorized client permissions and available API credits are separate requirements.
